summary: Owen Hill lookout near Houston, BC: built 1957, manned until 1983 and used as a radio relay; restored in 2012 and now a recreation site with a tenting deck.

access.note: Designated BC recreation site, reached by a forest road and a trail of about 2 km.

visit.trail_note: About 2 km trail, rated moderate, reached from the Morice River forest road about 30 km from Houston.

notes_for_editor: History is well sourced from the 2012 newspaper and government release. Present condition rests only on the undated Houston Hikers page; no dated 2026 source. Coordinates conflict: the brief (BC rec site) gives 54.186349, -126.86827 and the Canada Lookouts listing gives 54.182, -126.853, about 1 km apart; not corrected here. The brief's agency (Recreation Sites and Trails BC with Houston Hikers Society) is unverified: the sitesandtrailsbc REC32715 page would not fetch, so no agency fact is written. Lead on the 2012 restoration differs between the ministry release (ministry project, society a partner) and the society page (society spearheaded it with a centennial grant); both are reported. The 2012 article says manned about 20 years but gives 1983 as the last year and does not say when staffing began. Story Lookout (1990, Morice Mountain) is a separate tower and is not covered. Fact-check 2026-10-20: the Houston Hikers page carries no date, so the story says the page lists features rather than that they are current today. Forest road is the page's own directions (Morice River FSR, about 30 km from Houston). Keefe's communication-link remark concerns the lookout men's link within the Ministry of Forests (Houston Today), so the story attributes it that way. The 1989 status is worded as the article gives it (considered a secondary lookout).
